explanation: A young king of Judah who ruled righteously and worked to repair the temple.
A high priest who guided and supported Joash in his rule and reforms.
A holy place where the Israelites worshiped God and offered sacrifices.
The work of restoring or fixing something that is damaged, in this case the temple.
A room or building where valuable items and money are kept; here it refers to the temple treasury.
Gathering money or resources from the people for a specific purpose, here to fund the repair of the temple.
People who perform manual labor, in this context those who repaired the temple.
Skilled professionals working with specialized abilities, such as carpenters, stonecutters, and metalworkers, involved in the temple's repair.
